Employee.UpdateSalaryByCode: update employee set salary=@newSalary where EmployeeCode = @EmployeeCode
Employee.GetTotalNumberEmployeeInPositio: select count(*) from employee where PositionID = @PositionId
Employee.GetByPagingV2: select * from employee e left join employee_finance ef on e.EmployeeID = ef.EmployeeID left join department d on e.departmentID = d.departmentID left join position p on e.positionID = p.positionID limit @Limit offset @Offset
